title: Service icon redesign — Negotiation & Asesoramiento legal
brief: Redesign the two unreadable glyphs of the Damero Propiedades service icon set (handshake, pen-seal). The other six stay. Candidates must hold the DESIGN.md §8 duotone contract and read at 24–30px inside a 48px badge.

artboards.title: Diagnosis
artboards.tradeoff: Explains why the two current glyphs fail at badge size and shows the four rejected candidates; costs a full board before any proposal

artboards.title: Negociación — three proposals
artboards.tradeoff: Keeps the literal handshake via Lucide geometry, tuned two ways, plus an abstract dialogue option

artboards.title: Asesoramiento legal — three proposals
artboards.tradeoff: Three different objects (shield, scale, seal) chosen against the service copy's promise of a safe operation
